# Components {#sec-components}

These components are used at every level. Components added by higher levels
are listed in each level's chapter and in @sec-cards.

| Component             | Quantity | Notes                              |
|-----------------------|---------:|------------------------------------|
| Game board            | 1        | 8 × 8 grid                         |
| Pieces                | 32       | 8 per player, in four colours      |
| Superposition markers | 16       | Show where a split piece might be  |
| Entanglement cords    | 8        | Link two entangled pieces          |
| Measurement dice      | 2        |                                    |
